## Case studies

- **Ardoise.it**
  - status: production-ready, first client going live
  - route: `/fr/realisations/ardoise-it` | `/en/projects/ardoise-it`
  - type: multi-tenant SaaS for independent restaurants
  - features: QR ordering, pay-at-table, reservations, delivery, analytics
  - model: one site per restaurant, zero commission
  - architecture: Clean Architecture
  - data: one shared `PostgreSQL`, app filter + Row-Level Security
  - UI: `Blazor SSR` public sites + `Blazor Server` dashboard
  - payments: `Stripe Connect` (PCI SAQ-A)
  - hosting: Clever Cloud (EU sovereign)
  - code: ~17k lines
  - tests: ~18.5k lines
- **DPELib**
  - route: `/fr/realisations/dpelib` | `/en/projects/dpelib`
  - type: RegTech platform, France energy-performance diagnostic
  - audiences: 5
  - privacy: anonymous-by-default, conditional identity reveal
  - payments: pre-authorized, captured on confirmation (`Stripe` 3DS2)
  - data: nightly `data.gouv.fr` import
  - architecture: Clean Architecture
  - use cases: 153
  - endpoints: 117
  - data store: `SQL Server`
  - hosting: Azure Container Apps
  - compliance: GDPR / CNIL / PSD2
- **Brasa Geneva**
  - live: `https://www.brasageneva.ch`
  - route: `/fr/realisations/brasageneva` | `/en/projects/brasageneva`
  - type: full platform for a Geneva cigar club
  - faces: age-gated showcase + member area + secure dashboard
  - domain: regulated e-commerce (tobacco advertising, cross-border ban, age-gate, GDPR)
  - architecture: Clean Architecture
  - use cases: 99
  - locales: 7
  - test/code ratio: 2.2:1
  - hosting: Infomaniak (Swiss sovereign)
- **Other client sites**
  - `K-RO SQUARE` (krosquare.fr)
  - `Monseigneur Champagne` (monseigneurchampagne.com)
